evidence.title: TrendForce Global IC Substrate Market Analysis 2025
evidence.excerpt: Ibiden Co., Ltd. holds approximately 22% global IC substrate revenue share as of 2025, maintaining market leadership in premium ABF substrates for AI accelerators and HPC applications.
evidence.summary: TrendForce market analysis confirming Ibiden's ~22% global IC substrate market share and leadership position in advanced ABF substrates (2025).

evidence.title: Ibiden Dominates Premium ABF Substrate Supply for AI Accelerators
evidence.excerpt: Ibiden estimated to hold 40% of premium ABF substrate supply for AI accelerators, with capacity expansion at Ono and Kawama facilities ramping through 2027.
evidence.summary: DigiTimes reporting on Ibiden's dominant position in high-end ABF substrates for AI compute, with ongoing capacity expansion.

evidence.title: Ibiden Substrate Capacity Expansion Timeline (Ono & Kawama Facilities)
evidence.excerpt: Ibiden's Ono fab expansion and new Kawama facility expected to reach full production capacity by Q3 2027, adding ~18 months of ramp time from current state.
evidence.summary: Nikkei Asia reporting on Ibiden's substrate capacity expansion timeline and investment in Japan manufacturing.

evidence.title: ASE Advanced Packaging Capacity Expansion for AI Accelerators
evidence.excerpt: ASE Technology Holding's advanced 2.5D/3D packaging capacity estimated at ~85k wafer-per-month (WPM) in 2025-2026, positioning it as a key secondary source to TSMC CoWoS for AI accelerator modules.
evidence.summary: DigiTimes reporting on ASE's role as secondary packaging source with CoWoS-equivalent capacity for AI compute demand.

evidence.title: Advanced Packaging: Multi-Source Competition TSMC CoWoS, Samsung I-Cube, ASE
evidence.excerpt: TSMC CoWoS dominates advanced packaging with 60%+ share; Samsung I-Cube/SAINT and ASE expanding capacity to capture spillover AI accelerator demand. Market concentration risk drives customer diversification strategies.
evidence.summary: DigiTimes analysis of advanced 2.5D/3D packaging market structure and competition among TSMC, Samsung, and ASE.

evidence.title: Samsung I-Cube and SAINT Advanced Packaging for AI Accelerators
evidence.excerpt: Samsung Electronics' I-Cube and SAINT-class 2.5D/3D packaging technologies position the company as strategic second source to TSMC CoWoS, with ~15-20% estimated share in premium advanced packaging for AI accelerator modules (2025-2026).
evidence.summary: Nikkei Asia reporting on Samsung's advanced packaging strategy and market positioning as alternative to TSMC for AI compute.
